answer: Each identity must bill its compute through a separately metered energy river—one utility account or cloud invoice per seat—and publish hashed watt-hour readings every epoch. A public randomness beacon then opens random sample windows so peers can match billed joules to submitted work. Identities whose traces spiral into the same meter or billing profile collapse to a single reward. A sybil operator must open and fully fund a unique energy account for every clone and pay real electricity or cloud invoices, so idle keys earn nothing.
